nodes.label: Shared design laws OKLCH theme typography

nodes.label: Cognitive Load
nodes.rationale: Overloaded users make mistakes and leave; distinguish intrinsic task complexity from extraneous waste caused by bad design and preserve germane learning effort.

nodes.label: Working Memory Rule
nodes.rationale: Humans hold <=4 items in working memory (Cowan revision of Miller); exceed it and users skip, misclick, or abandon.

nodes.label: Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Reveal complexity only when needed to manage intrinsic load and support germane learning without overwhelming working memory.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color
nodes.rationale: HSL steps are not perceptually uniform; OKLCH keeps equal lightness steps looking equal and requires reducing chroma near white/black.

nodes.label: WCAG Contrast Requirements
nodes.rationale: Placeholder gray usually fails; body text needs 4.5:1 AA and UI components 3:1, never rely on color alone.

nodes.label: Tinted Neutrals
nodes.rationale: Pure gray feels lifeless next to brand color; tiny chroma 0.005-0.015 hued toward brand creates subconscious cohesion.

nodes.label: Strategic Color Introduction
nodes.rationale: More color is not better; every color needs semantic purpose, hierarchy, or emotional tone matched to brand strategy.

nodes.label: Semantic Color
nodes.rationale: Reserve consistent meanings for success/error/warning/info so color communicates state across every screen.

nodes.label: Craft Flow
nodes.rationale: Code-first generation discovers weaker visual lanes; confirmed brief plus north-star mock plus browser iteration are required to reach studio bar.

nodes.label: North-Star Mock
nodes.rationale: Mock is visual contract for composition and motifs, not screenshot to trace; missing major ingredients in code is blocking defect.

nodes.label: Dual Assessment Critique
nodes.rationale: Isolated LLM review and deterministic detector stay honest only when neither sees the other; anchoring would corrupt combined score.

nodes.label: Design Health Score
nodes.rationale: Honest 0-4 scoring per heuristic prevents grade inflation; most real interfaces score 20-32 out of 40.

nodes.label: Delight Moments
nodes.rationale: Delight amplifies but never blocks; quick skippable surprises at success, empty, loading, and error moments turn tool into experience.

nodes.label: Micro-interactions
nodes.rationale: Subtle button press, hover lift, and success animation add personality without obscuring task completion.

nodes.label: Design Simplification
nodes.rationale: Simplicity removes obstacles not features; ruthless editing reveals essence and reduces cognitive load.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md System
nodes.rationale: Tokens are normative and prose is contextual; fixed six-section order keeps file parseable by Stitch and other DESIGN.md tools.

nodes.label: DESIGN.json Sidecar
nodes.rationale: Frontmatter cannot hold shadows, motion, or snippets; sidecar extends rather than duplicates token primitives.

nodes.label: Pattern Extraction
nodes.rationale: Premature abstraction is worse than duplication; only extract patterns used 3+ times with same intent.

nodes.label: Resilience Hardening
nodes.rationale: Designs that only work with perfect data are not production-ready; harden against extreme inputs, failures, and concurrency.

nodes.label: Internationalization Support
nodes.rationale: German expands 30 percent and RTL flips direction; fixed widths and English-only pluralization break globally.

nodes.label: Nielsen's 10 Heuristics
nodes.rationale: Ten heuristics scored 0-4 give comparable coverage from system status to help and documentation.

nodes.label: Issue Severity P0-P3
nodes.rationale: P0 blocks task completion while P3 is polish; support-contact test disambiguates borderline levels.

nodes.label: Eight Interactive States
nodes.rationale: Hover without focus or vice versa excludes keyboard users; all eight states from default to success must be designed.

nodes.label: Focus Ring
nodes.rationale: Removing outline without replacement violates accessibility; focus-visible shows ring only for keyboard users.

nodes.label: Popover and Anchor Positioning
nodes.rationale: Absolute dropdowns clip inside overflow hidden; top layer plus anchor positioning or portal escapes clipping without z-index wars.

nodes.label: Visual Rhythm and Spacing System
nodes.rationale: Space is design material; consistent scale with tight grouping and generous separation creates hierarchy where equal spacing creates monotony.

nodes.label: Live Variant Mode
nodes.rationale: Hot-swapped variants with tunable params allow instant tuning without regeneration; composition weight determines param budget.

nodes.label: Identity Lock
nodes.rationale: Variation within identity avoids off-brand proposals; departure requires explicit trigger from anti-references or user prompt.

nodes.label: Motion Timing and Easing
nodes.rationale: Timing matters more than easing; 100/300/500ms tiers with exponential ease-out feel natural while bounce feels dated.

nodes.label: Reduced Motion Support
nodes.rationale: Vestibular disorders affect many adults; provide crossfade alternative and preserve functional animation without spatial movement.

nodes.label: Onboarding Flow
nodes.rationale: Get users to aha moment quickly; teach 20 percent delivering 80 percent value in context not upfront ceremony.

nodes.label: Empty States
nodes.rationale: Empty states are onboarding opportunities; explain what will appear, why it matters, and how to start.

nodes.label: Core Web Vitals Optimization
nodes.rationale: LCP under 2.5s, INP under 200ms, CLS under 0.1 define perceived quality; optimize hero, task splitting, and reserved space.

nodes.label: Loading Performance
nodes.rationale: Measure before optimizing; biggest bottleneck first with modern image formats, code splitting, and critical CSS.

nodes.label: Extraordinary Interaction
nodes.rationale: Wow differs by surface: sensory effects for marketing, feel and fluidity for functional UI, invisibility for performance-critical UI.

nodes.label: View Transitions API
nodes.rationale: Shared element morphing gives closest-to-native FLIP; must degrade gracefully with supports checks and reduced-motion fallback.

nodes.label: Persona-Based Testing
nodes.rationale: Single director perspective misses failure modes; five archetypes from power user to distracted mobile expose different breaks.

nodes.label: Accessibility-Dependent User Sam
nodes.rationale: Screen reader and keyboard-only flow requires focusability, ARIA, 4.5:1 contrast, and no color-only meaning.

nodes.label: Final Polish Pass
nodes.rationale: Polish is last not first; meticulous detail pass separates shipped from great only after functional completeness.

nodes.label: Design System Alignment
nodes.rationale: Polish without alignment is decoration on drift; classify deviation as missing token, one-off implementation, or conceptual misalignment.

nodes.label: Product Register
nodes.rationale: Tool should disappear into task; earned familiarity beats strangeness, so system fonts and standard affordances are virtues.

nodes.label: Restrained Color Strategy
nodes.rationale: Product defaults to restrained with accent only for primary actions and state indicators, not decoration.

nodes.label: Visual Quieting
nodes.rationale: Quiet is refined not boring; reduce saturation and weight while preserving hierarchy and character through restraint.
